heat.basis: Impact 85: named as the limiting factor by name, not inferred. Projectile metal-part production is reported as the limiting factor against the Army's 100,000 round-per-month goal (36,000/month achieved as of March 2026), and the purpose-built Mesquite plant has produced no conforming parts despite $469 million invested. On the missile side the same link is being bought directly: Northrop is adding THAAD structural work and ATI's own first-quarter missile revenue doubled year over year. Crowdedness 55, held out of money_corner (needs <=40): the listed proxy is followed, but the reported price-target moves were driven primarily by commercial aerospace strength with only modest sentiment around defense exposure specifically, so the attention sits on a different bet (the aerospace cycle) than the one this link describes (the projectile-parts qualification bottleneck). EMERGING rather than UNDISCOVERED for that reason: the theme is known, ATI's specific choke-point role inside it is not.
